title: 麻将胡了 2 金龙抬爪摆动动效候选（Kling）
prompt: Create a clearly animated seamless 5-second portrait loop from this exact image. Camera stays completely locked. The golden dragon must visibly move throughout the clip: its raised head makes a small powerful turn toward the viewer and back; the two visible front legs alternately reach forward; the five separate claws on the nearest front paw open, flex, and close once so the paw motion is unmistakable; a traveling wave moves down the torso into the tail; mane, whiskers, and tail stream with the movement. The motion should be broad enough to notice at phone-card size, while the dragon retains one continuous body and the same limb count, face, gold armor, and overall S-curve. The face-up mahjong tiles remain fixed in place with their bamboo, circle, and red 中 markings sharp and unchanged. Complete the motion and return to the exact starting pose at the end for a clean loop.
